meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想为Claude定制专属技能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build custom skills for Claude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你按步骤创建或更新技能，包括理解需求、规划脚本与文档、生成模板、编辑和打包，帮你设计高效的技能文件结构。
howto.when: 当你想要创建或更新一个扩展 Claude 能力的技能，或者询问如何制作技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的PDF处理技能
say.note: Claude 会开始询问需求并引导创建流程。

say.text: 如何编写一个高效的SKILL.md文件？
say.note: Claude 会提供核心原则和结构指南。

say.text: 我想为我的博客创建内容生成技能
say.note: Claude 会帮你规划资源和脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through steps to create or update a skill: understanding needs, planning scripts and docs, generating templates, editing, and packaging, helping you design an efficient skill file structure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create or update a skill to extend Claude's capabilities, or when you ask how to create a skill.

say_en.text: Help me create a new PDF processing skill.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about requirements and start the creation process.

say_en.text: How do I write an effective SKILL.md?
say_en.note: Claude will provide core principles and structure guidance.

say_en.text: I want to create a content generation skill for my blog.
say_en.note: Claude will help you plan resources and scripts.
